title.narrative: Programming of the EU Anti-Corruption Initiative in Ukraine 1/1 2023 – July 2024

description.narrative: - Ensuring integrity, transparency and accountability of utilizing international reconstruction (and humanitarian) aid. The EUACI will work through its national and local partners in promoting the necessary oversight of these funds. The program will facilitate high-level political dialogue to create the necessary attention to these issues and ensure local ownership to the necessary mechanisms that will need to be in place to ensure oversight at national and local level. - EU integration efforts in the field of anti-corruption. The EUACI will support its partners in the EU integration process through support to anti-corruption reforms, law approximation, exchanges with European partners and by providing international expertise.

To complete the assignment, the consultant is expected to lead the formulation of the documents. The consultant will: • Assess updated documentation from partners and context. • Engage in dialogue with EUACI, MFA and EU on content of addendum documents. • Ensure synergies with other relevant MFA supported programmes and projects in line with the “Doing Development Differently” approach. This includes the global programme on anti-corruption currently being formulated. • Consult with other relevant stakeholders and programs as needed. • Ensure that the basis for the EUACI will not become too complex and that it is implementable and sustainable with a high impact given the context. • Ensure that the EUACI will have sufficient flexibility and be able to adapt to developments given the unstable context in line with the MFA adaptive management approach. • Incorporate the four thematic issues across the work of the program. • Incorporate the extensive work on legislative and political development. • Consider aspects of terminating the program in July 2024 and lay out possible tracks for an extension. • Together with EUACI consult partners virtually for a first drafting of engagement document on advance of mission to Kyiv • Draft first version of documents with partners
